title: GLING [1 Count 64 oz. Wide-Mouth Glass Mason Jars with Metal Airtight Lids and Bands 2 Quart Large For Preserving, & Meal Prep
description:
About this item
Glass Mason Jars W/ Lids- 1 set of 64 oz. ball canning jars and lids that are super for preserving and meal prep. These mason jars 64 oz are ideal for fruits, vegetables, pickles, sauces, treats, dry foods, beans etc.
Wide Mouth- these are wide mouth mason jars, allowing for super easy pouring sauces, dressings; scooping- regular spoon gets to all corners sufficiently; and cleaning easily stick in that cloth and get cleaning.
Leak Proof Lid- tightly sealable lid prevents messy spills and leaks, and seals in the freshness and delicious flavor. Just twist the cap of these ball jars and relax.
Superior Quality Glass- its thick walls, smooth finish and gleaming glass beautifies your event and home, and allows you to see the inner contents.

reviews_5s:
I ordered the GLING 64 oz. Wide-Mouth Glass Mason Jar for pantry storage and meal prep, and I’m really impressed with the quality and performance so far.

The glass is thick and durable, giving it a solid, premium feel without being overly heavy. It’s large enough to hold bulk pantry staples like oats, flour, or pasta, and the wide mouth makes scooping and filling super easy—a must for anyone who uses these jars frequently for dry goods or fermentation projects.

The metal airtight lid and band seal tightly, which is especially important for preserving freshness. I tested it by storing some homemade cold brew and, after several days in the fridge, it was still fresh with no leaking or metallic aftertaste. The seal held beautifully.

✅ PRO TIP: If you’re planning to use this for liquids, I’d recommend not overfilling and checking the seal after the first twist—it's snug, but making sure it's fully tightened will prevent any spills.

While this is sold as a single jar, the price reflects the quality and size. A full 64 oz (2 quarts) is ideal for fermenting small batches of kombucha or storing large soup portions for meal prep. The versatility alone makes this a great value.

My only minor caution: since it’s a single jar, it might not make sense for everyone unless you're buying it for a specific need.
